title: Pro Shop Store Credit: fraud-suspension and reinstatement basis
content:
## Basis
A Pro Shop Store Credit account placed on a fraud-review hold may remain suspended for no longer than that tier's own maximum fraud-hold days. Bringing the account back to active status through reinstatement requires a documented review where that tier calls for one, and the tier's own standing reinstatement fee, if any is set for that tier, is charged at the point of reinstatement. Where a suspended account is instead confirmed as fraudulent, it is administratively closed rather than reinstated.

## Restated
| Situation | Basis that applies |
|---|---|
| Account suspended for fraud review | May remain suspended no longer than the tier's own maximum fraud-hold days |
| Reinstatement, where the tier requires a documented review | Requires that documented review before the hold is lifted |
| Reinstatement | The tier's own standing reinstatement fee, if any, is charged |
| Suspended account confirmed fraudulent | Administratively closed rather than reinstated |

## Points of judgement
The maximum fraud-hold days bounds how long the suspension itself may run; it does not by itself authorise reinstatement — where the tier requires a documented review, that review is required before the hold is lifted regardless of how many days remain within the maximum. A tier whose standing reinstatement fee is 0 charges nothing at reinstatement beyond whatever the current handling basis for reinstatement separately adds.
